These partition C modulo finitely many endpoints, all mapping onto C. Branch inverse lengths 1/d² or 1/d imply iid cylinder probabilities and normalized Lebesgue invariant section law. The finite roof suspension is invariant and ergodic; a positive-area planar strip maps to C so the basin has positive area. Weighted direct sums yield m=(d+1)(3d+1)/(2d), Var(T)=(d−1)(d+1)(d²−2d+3)/(12d²); entropy and positive Lyapunov by induced entropy/return derivative are 2 ln d/(3d+1), with a rank-collapse exponent −∞; inverse iid renewal CLT has variance Var/m³. An independent exact rational orbit reconstruction checked 297 branch points for d=2..10; all-d proof uses affine identities, not finite extrapolation.
